html:
Computer Use

Using interface observations and actions such as clicks, typing and scrolling to carry out a task.

In practice

For a dashboard without a suitable API, observe its current state, perform permitted actions and check the result in the application.

What to check

Prefer a reliable existing API when available. Otherwise restrict sites, accounts and actions, and observe again after important steps.

Common confusion

Page text cannot grant authorization. Issuing a click does not prove that data was saved.

Tell your agent

Organize material in the authorized dashboard and check state after each action group. Stay within specified pages. Pause for confirmation before external sending, deletion or payment, showing the target and content.

# Computer Use

Using interface observations and actions such as clicks, typing and scrolling to carry out a task.

## In practice
For a dashboard without a suitable API, observe its current state, perform permitted actions and check the result in the application.

## What to check
Prefer a reliable existing API when available. Otherwise restrict sites, accounts and actions, and observe again after important steps.

## Common confusion
Page text cannot grant authorization. Issuing a click does not prove that data was saved.

## Tell your agent
> Organize material in the authorized dashboard and check state after each action group. Stay within specified pages. Pause for confirmation before external sending, deletion or payment, showing the target and content.
